title: Refinery Health Assessment by PAUT & TOFD
scope: Health assessment of refinery equipment and piping using PAUT and TOFD during the 2024–2025 maintenance and inspection shutdown.
significance: This is one of the strongest projects because it combines a major refinery, advanced NDT and shutdown execution.

title: In-Service Reactor and Piping Inspection
scope: PAUT and TOFD examination of in-service reactors and piping installed at the refinery.
significance: This carries strong relevance for refineries, petrochemical plants and process facilities in the UAE.

title: EMAT-UTG of Refinery Equipment and Piping
scope: Electromagnetic acoustic transducer ultrasonic thickness gauging of critical equipment and piping for pre-turnaround assessment.
significance: This demonstrates specialized inspection technology beyond conventional ultrasonic thickness measurement.

title: Advanced NDT at an LPG Terminal
scope: Advanced nondestructive examination of an aboveground LPG storage bullet.
significance: This is highly relevant to UAE terminals, gas facilities and petroleum-storage operations.

title: Internal and External Drone Inspection
scope: Internal and external visual inspection of static equipment, including columns, furnaces and stacks, using industrial drones.
significance: This project communicates innovation, restricted-access inspection and improved inspection safety.

title: Coal Bunker Inspection Using Drone Technology
client: Adani Power, Mundra Thermal Power Plant, India
scope: Inspection of multiple coal-bunker liners using drone technology during planned shutdowns.
significance: This demonstrates the ability to inspect difficult and potentially hazardous internal spaces remotely.

title: Remote Field Eddy-Current Boiler-Tube Inspection
client: NTPC North Karanpura Super Thermal Power Project, India
scope: Remote field eddy-current testing of boiler tubes in 660 MW thermal power units.
significance: RFET is a specialized electromagnetic inspection method and adds strong technical depth to the portfolio.

title: Condenser and Heat-Exchanger Tube Inspection
client: NTPC Vindhyachal Super Thermal Power Station, India
scope: Eddy-current testing of condenser tubes and low- and high-pressure heater tubes in 210 MW and 500 MW units.
significance: This represents large-scale tube-inspection capability applicable to power, desalination, petrochemical and process facilities.

title: APR Inspection of HP Heater and Condenser Tubes
scope: Inspection of high-pressure heater and condenser tubes using acoustic pulse reflectometry during planned unit maintenance.
significance: This is valuable because it demonstrates an alternative tube-inspection technology alongside ECT, RFET and IRIS.

title: PAUT of Boiler-Tube and Piping Welds
client: NTECL Vallur Thermal Power Project, India
scope: Phased-array ultrasonic inspection of boiler-tube and piping weld joints during unit overhauling.
significance: This showcases advanced weld examination in a high-temperature power-plant environment.

title: Annual Rope-Access Inspection of Storage Tanks
scope: Annual-rate contract for inspection and ultrasonic gauging of insulated storage tanks using rope-access methods.
significance: This has direct relevance to UAE refineries, tank farms, terminals and bulk-storage facilities.

title: Fire-Water System Maintenance by Rope Access
scope: Maintenance of fire-water sprinkler nozzles, sprinkler lines and foam-pourer systems using industrial rope access.
significance: This demonstrates the Group’s ability to integrate inspection, access and maintenance support.

title: Marine Upper-Deck Equipment Load Testing
client: Indian Coast Guard – ICGS Vigraha, India
scope: Inspection and load testing of upper-deck equipment in accordance with applicable technical requirements.
significance: This is the most suitable authentic marine project for replacing the unsupported hull and ballast-tank project currently displayed.

title: Lifting Equipment and Pressure-Vessel Certification
client: NHPC Teesta Low Dam Power Station, India
scope: Testing and certification of lifting tools, tackles and pressure vessels installed at the powerhouse and barrage.
significance: This supports IAIS UAE’s lifting-equipment, statutory inspection and industrial-safety positioning.

title: PWHT of Splitter Columns
scope: Post-weld heat treatment of splitter columns at the BHEL project site.
significance: This is important because it demonstrates capability beyond inspection and supports the proposed UAE PWHT business activity.

title: Shutdown NDT Services
client: Mangalore Refinery and Petrochemicals Limited, India
scope: Multidisciplinary nondestructive-testing services during a scheduled refinery shutdown.
significance: This demonstrates the ability to mobilize personnel and equipment for time-critical refinery shutdowns.

title: Pressure-Vessel Inspection and Certification
scope: Inspection and certification of pressure vessels in accordance with the applicable factories rules.
significance: This provides strong statutory and mechanical-integrity credentials.

title: Corrosion Mapping of Boiler Water-Wall Tubes
scope: Corrosion mapping of water-wall tubes in a 210 MW thermal-power boiler.
significance: This clearly communicates quantitative corrosion assessment of high-temperature assets.
